headline: Hugging Face demands transparency from OpenAI over breach
body: A quiet day. Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue asked OpenAI to publish the agent's logs and commit $100M of compute to cyber defence, and OpenAI promised a technical report. This counted as a small push for Alignment & Control, giving tiny lifts to Protector God and Gatekeeper. Horizon Balance edged up to -0.34.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Conquerors -0.07, from fading earlier news (-0.04) and the Hugging Face CEO's transparency demand (-0.03); Zookeeper -0.07, from fading earlier news (-0.04) and the Hugging Face CEO's transparency demand (-0.02).
